name: MiniCPM-V 4.5
purpose: Efficient on-device multimodal model with strong OCR and document parsing and video through a 3D resampler.

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: card section "License": "weights and code are open-sourced under the Apache-2.0 license"; the OpenBMB/MiniCPM-V GitHub LICENSE read is the unmodified Apache-2.0 text

architecture.kind: dense vision-language, LLaVA-UHD high-resolution slicing up to about 1.8 MP
architecture.why_this_design: OCR and document knowledge learned jointly by corrupting text regions and reconstructing them, to avoid reliance on error-prone parsers and reduce hallucination; unified 3D resampler packs 6 frames into 64 tokens (card).

engine_support.notes: card says llama.cpp via a fork with an upstream PR 15575

strengths: OCRBench and OmniDocBench leadership claimed among general MLLMs (no numbers given)
weaknesses: no numbers on the card for document tasks
soft.maturity: OpenBMB ships regularly; a 4.6 1B model is mentioned only by blogs

tona_fit.reason: Apache-2.0 verified, 8.7B on every 16 GB class, but no independent German or document score and overtaken on documented document numbers by Qwen3-VL and Qwen3.5
